items.question: What does JDMatch do?
items.answer: JDMatch is an AI-powered resume matching tool: upload your resume and a target JD, and it automatically rewrites and optimizes the resume to fit the role, producing a ready-to-send derived resume.

items.question: Do I need to log in?
items.answer: Yes. AI capabilities are served centrally to prevent resource abuse, so you must register with a registration code and log in. The code credits the new account.

items.question: What export formats are supported?
items.answer: We currently support PDF export, ensuring your resume maintains consistent formatting on any device. We plan to support more export formats in the future.

items.question: Is my resume data secure?
items.answer: Your resumes and match records are stored under your logged-in account and isolated from other accounts — visible only to you.

items.question: What if my credits run out?
items.answer: Credits are granted by the registration code used at sign-up. A resume match costs 5 credits and a pitch generation costs 1 credit. Once exhausted, no further requests can be started. To top up, click 'Get a registration code' above to claim a new code for free.

faqDialog.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faqDialog.description: Common tips for editing, previewing, and exporting your resume.

markdown-editor.question: How do I edit my resume and see the live preview?
markdown-editor.answer: Edit the content in the Markdown editor on the left and the live preview on the right will update with it. You can adjust line height, font size, page padding, and section spacing from the preview toolbar.

preview-panel.question: How do I expand or collapse the live preview?
preview-panel.answer: Click the eye button in the floating toolbar on the right to toggle the live preview. When collapsed, the editor uses the full workspace; click the eye button again to restore the preview.

pdf-export.question: How do I export my resume as a PDF?
pdf-export.answer: Click the export button in the floating toolbar and use server PDF export for consistent layout rendering. If server export is temporarily unavailable, use the browser print option to save the current preview as a PDF.

resume-management.question: How do I switch templates or duplicate the current resume?
resume-management.answer: Use the template button in the floating toolbar to switch the current resume's layout. Use the copy button to create and open a duplicate for continued editing; the original resume remains unchanged.
